ei.title: Practice 03 — 인터넷의 정보를 평가할 수 있는 비판적 사고능력의 중요성
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본2

fullPassage: The upside of the Internet is that it is democratic ― anyone can say what they like ― but the downside is that there is no quality control. Far from being an electronic oracle infallibly dispensing wisdom, it contains the views not only of credentialed experts but also of uninformed idiots ― and everything in between. There is, of course, a huge amount of useful, accurate and trustworthy information online, but it is not always easy to find. Search engines like Google may help, but it is important to keep in mind that page rankings are determined by popularity rather than truth. Since conspiracy theories surrounding events such as 9/11 are popular, they are likely to appear high on such rankings, but this does not mean they are true. So if we are to avoid being misled, we need not only the ability to locate information, but also the critical thinking skills to evaluate it.

questions.passage: The upside of the Internet is that it is (A)[democratic / controlled] ― anyone can say what they like ― but the downside is that there is no quality control. Far from being an electronic oracle infallibly (B)[dispensing / withholding] wisdom, it contains the views not only of credentialed experts but also of uninformed idiots ― and everything in between. There is, of course, a huge amount of useful, (C)[accurate / inaccurate] and trustworthy information online, but it is not always easy to find. Search engines like Google may help, but it is important to keep in mind that page rankings are determined by popularity rather than truth. Since conspiracy theories surrounding events such as 9/11 are popular, they are likely to appear high on such rankings, but this does not mean they are true. So if we are to avoid being misled, we need not only the ability to locate information, but also the critical thinking skills to evaluate it.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) democratic=민주적인, (B) dispensing=전달하는, (C) accurate=정확한
det.analysis:
❌ ① democratic — dispensing — inaccurate: (C) inaccurate(부정확한)는 accurate(정확한)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ② controlled — dispensing — accurate: (A) controlled(통제된)는 democratic(민주적인)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ③ democratic — withholding — accurate: (B) withholding(보류하는)은 dispensing(전달하는)의 반의어로 부적절
✅ ④ democratic — dispensing — accurate: 원문 일치. 인터넷은 민주적이고(democratic), 지혜를 전달하는(dispensing) 오라클처럼 보이나, 실제로는 정확한(accurate) 정보만 있지 않음
det.tip: democratic Internet(민주적인 인터넷) + dispensing wisdom(지혜를 전달하다) + accurate information(정확한 정보)

questions.passage: The upside of the Internet is that it is democratic ― anyone can say what they like ― but the downside is that there is no quality control. Far from being an electronic oracle infallibly dispensing wisdom, it contains the views not only of (A)[credentialed / uncredentialed] experts but also of uninformed idiots ― and everything in between. There is, of course, a huge amount of useful, accurate and trustworthy information online, but it is not always easy to find. Search engines like Google may help, but it is important to keep in mind that page rankings are determined by popularity rather than truth. Since conspiracy theories surrounding events such as 9/11 are (B)[popular / unpopular], they are likely to appear high on such rankings, but this does not mean they are true. So if we are to avoid being misled, we need not only the ability to (C)[locate / ignore] information, but also the critical thinking skills to evaluate it.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) credentialed=자격을 갖춘, (B) popular=인기 있는, (C) locate=찾아내다
det.analysis:
❌ ① credentialed — popular — ignore: (C) ignore(무시하다)는 locate(찾아내다)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ② uncredentialed — popular — locate: (A) uncredentialed(자격 없는)는 credentialed(자격을 갖춘)의 반의어로 부적절
✅ ③ credentialed — popular — locate: 원문 일치. 자격을 갖춘(credentialed) 전문가들의 견해, 음모론이 인기 있어(popular) 높은 순위에 오름, 정보를 찾아내는(locate) 능력
❌ ④ credentialed — unpopular — locate: (B) unpopular(인기 없는)는 popular(인기 있는)의 반의어로 부적절
det.tip: credentialed experts(자격 갖춘 전문가) + popular conspiracy theories(인기 있는 음모론) + ability to locate(찾아내는 능력)

questions.passage: The upside of the Internet is that it is democratic ― anyone can say what they like ― but the downside is that there is no quality control. Far from being an electronic oracle infallibly dispensing wisdom, it contains the views not only of credentialed experts but also of uninformed idiots ― and everything in between. There is, of course, a huge amount of useful, accurate and (A)[trustworthy / unreliable] information online, but it is not always easy to find. Search engines like Google may help, but it is important to keep in mind that page rankings are (B)[determined / ignored] by popularity rather than truth. Since conspiracy theories surrounding events such as 9/11 are popular, they are likely to appear high on such rankings, but this does not mean they are true. So if we are to avoid being misled, we need not only the ability to locate information, but also the critical thinking skills to (C)[evaluate / accept] it.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) trustworthy=신뢰할 수 있는, (B) determined=결정되는, (C) evaluate=평가하다
det.analysis:
✅ ① trustworthy — determined — evaluate: 원문 일치. 신뢰할 수 있는(trustworthy) 정보가 있지만, 순위는 진실이 아닌 인기도로 결정되고(determined), 비판적 사고로 평가해야(evaluate) 함
❌ ② unreliable — determined — evaluate: (A) unreliable(신뢰할 수 없는)은 trustworthy(신뢰할 수 있는)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ③ trustworthy — ignored — evaluate: (B) ignored(무시된)는 determined(결정된)와 의미상 대립하여 부적절
❌ ④ trustworthy — determined — accept: (C) accept(받아들이다)는 evaluate(평가하다)와 반대 의미로, 비판적 사고가 필요한 문맥에 부적절
det.tip: trustworthy information(신뢰할 수 있는 정보) + determined by popularity(인기로 결정됨) + skills to evaluate(평가하는 기술)

questions.passage: The upside of the Internet is that it is ①<u>democratic</u> ― anyone can say what they like ― but the downside is that there is no quality control. Far from being an electronic oracle infallibly dispensing wisdom, it contains the views not only of credentialed experts but also of uninformed idiots ― and everything in between. There is, of course, a huge amount of useful, accurate and ②<u>trustworthy</u> information online, but it is not always easy to find. Search engines like Google may help, but it is important to keep in mind that page rankings are determined by popularity rather than truth. Since conspiracy theories surrounding events such as 9/11 are ③<u>trivial</u>, they are likely to appear high on such rankings, but this does not mean they are true. So if we are to avoid being misled, we need not only the ability to locate information, but also the critical thinking skills to ④<u>evaluate</u> it.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 인기 있는 음모론의 맥락에서 'popular'가 적절. 'trivial(하찮은)'은 부적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① democratic — 원문 일치. 인터넷이 누구나 발언 가능한 민주적 특성을 나타냄
❌ ② trustworthy — 원문 일치. 신뢰할 수 있는 정보가 온라인에 있다는 맥락에 적절
✅ ③ trivial — 원문은 popular(인기 있는). 음모론이 검색 순위에 높게 오르는 이유는 인기 때문이므로, trivial(하찮은)은 문맥과 모순
❌ ④ evaluate — 원문 일치. 정보를 비판적으로 평가해야 한다는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: conspiracy theories are popular(음모론은 인기 있다) → 검색 순위 높음. trivial(하찮은)으로 바꾸면 '인기 없는' 의미가 되어 논리 붕괴

questions.passage: The upside of the Internet is that it is ①<u>democratic</u> ― anyone can say what they like ― but the downside is that there is no ②<u>free access</u>. Far from being an electronic oracle infallibly dispensing wisdom, it contains the views not only of credentialed experts but also of uninformed idiots ― and everything in between. There is, of course, a huge amount of ③<u>useful</u>, accurate and trustworthy information online, but it is not always easy to find. Search engines like Google may help, but it is important to keep in mind that page rankings are determined by popularity rather than truth. Since conspiracy theories surrounding events such as 9/11 are popular, they are likely to appear high on such rankings, but this does not mean they are true. So if we are to avoid being ④<u>misled</u>, we need not only the ability to locate information, but also the critical thinking skills to evaluate it.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 인터넷의 단점은 '품질 관리'가 없는 것. 'free access(자유로운 접근)'는 단점이 아닌 장점으로 부적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① democratic — 원문 일치. 인터넷이 누구나 발언 가능한 민주적 특성으로 적절
✅ ② free access — 원문은 quality control(품질 관리). 인터넷의 단점은 품질 관리가 없다는 것이므로, free access(자유로운 접근)는 장점으로 단점 설명 맥락에 부적절
❌ ③ useful — 원문 일치. 유용하고 정확한 정보가 온라인에 존재한다는 맥락에 적절
❌ ④ misled — 원문 일치. 잘못 인도되는 것을 피하려면 비판적 사고가 필요하다는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: the downside is that there is no quality control(단점=품질 관리 없음). free access로 바꾸면 '장점'이 '단점'으로 제시되어 모순

questions.passage: The upside of the Internet is that it is democratic ― anyone can say what they like ― but the downside is that there is no quality control. Far from being an electronic oracle ②<u>infallibly</u> dispensing wisdom, it contains the views not only of credentialed experts but also of ①<u>well-read</u> idiots ― and everything in between. There is, of course, a huge amount of useful, accurate and trustworthy information online, but it is not always easy to find. Search engines like Google may help, but it is important to keep in mind that page rankings are determined by ③<u>popularity</u> rather than truth. Since conspiracy theories surrounding events such as 9/11 are popular, they are likely to appear high on such rankings, but this does not mean they are true. So if we are to avoid being misled, we need not only the ability to locate information, but also the ④<u>critical thinking</u> skills to evaluate it.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 전문가와 대비되는 무지한(uninformed) 사람들. 'well-read(박식한)'는 대조 구조 붕괴로 부적절
det.analysis:
✅ ① well-read — 원문은 uninformed(무지한). 전문가와 대비되는 무지한 사람들의 견해도 담긴다는 맥락에서, well-read(박식한)로 바꾸면 전문가와 대비가 사라져 부적절
❌ ② infallibly — 원문 일치. 인터넷이 '절대 틀리지 않게' 지혜를 전달하는 오라클이라는 반어적 표현으로 적절
❌ ③ popularity — 원문 일치. 검색 순위가 진실이 아닌 인기도로 결정된다는 맥락에 적절
❌ ④ critical thinking — 원문 일치. 정보를 평가하는 비판적 사고 기술이 필요하다는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: uninformed idiots(무지한 멍청이들) vs credentialed experts(자격 갖춘 전문가) — 대조 구조. well-read로 바꾸면 대조가 무너짐

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 인터넷의 단점 = 품질 관리(quality control)가 없다는 것
det.analysis:
❌ ① popularity: 인기도는 검색 순위 관련 개념으로 단점 설명과 불일치

det.korean: 정보 평가에 필요한 것 = 비판적 사고(critical thinking) 기술
det.analysis:
❌ ① locate information: 정보를 찾는 능력은 이미 'not only' 부분에 언급된 것으로, 'but also' 자리에 올 수 없음
✅ ② critical thinking: 원문의 핵심. 정보를 평가하기 위한 비판적 사고 기술
❌ ③ dispensing wisdom: 지혜를 전달하는 것은 인터넷 오라클 비유로, 필요한 기술이 아님

det.korean: democratic = 모두에게 열린(open to all), 누구나 발언 가능한

❌ ② strictly regulated: 엄격히 규제된으로 democratic과 반의 관계
❌ ③ commercially driven: 상업적으로 운영되는으로 의미 불일치
❌ ④ government-controlled: 정부 통제로 democratic과 반의 관계
det.tip: anyone can say what they like = democratic(민주적/개방적) → open to all

det.analysis:
❌ ① amateur: 아마추어로 credentialed(자격을 갖춘)와 반의 관계

questions.passage: The upside of the Internet is that it is democratic ― anyone can say what they like ― but the downside is that there is no quality control. Far from being an electronic oracle infallibly dispensing wisdom, it contains the views not only of credentialed experts but also of uninformed idiots ― and everything in between. There is, of course, a huge amount of useful, accurate and <u>trustworthy</u> information online, but it is not always easy to find. Search engines like Google may help, but it is important to keep in mind that page rankings are determined by popularity rather than truth. Since conspiracy theories surrounding events such as 9/11 are popular, they are likely to appear high on such rankings, but this does not mean they are true. So if we are to avoid being misled, we need not only the ability to locate information, but also the critical thinking skills to evaluate it.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 trustworthy와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: trustworthy(신뢰할 수 있는)의 반의어 = dubious(의심스러운, 신뢰할 수 없는)
det.analysis:
❌ ① credible: 믿을 수 있는으로 trustworthy와 동의어 관계
❌ ② reliable: 믿을 수 있는으로 trustworthy와 동의어 관계
✅ ③ dubious: 의심스러운, 불확실한으로 trustworthy(신뢰할 수 있는)의 반의어
❌ ④ authentic: 진본의, 믿을 수 있는으로 trustworthy와 동의어 관계
det.tip: trustworthy information(신뢰할 수 있는 정보) — 반의어: dubious(의심스러운)/unreliable(신뢰할 수 없는)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 infallibly와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: infallibly(절대 틀리지 않게)의 반의어 = fallibly(틀릴 수 있게)
det.analysis:
✅ ① fallibly: 틀릴 수 있게, 오류 가능성 있게로 infallibly(절대 틀리지 않게)의 반의어
❌ ② unerringly: 오류 없이로 infallibly와 동의어 관계
❌ ③ perfectly: 완벽하게로 infallibly와 유사 의미
❌ ④ reliably: 신뢰할 수 있게로 infallibly와 유사 의미
det.tip: infallibly = in(부정접두어) + fallibly(오류 가능하게). 반의어는 접두어 제거 = fallibly

questions.passage:
(A) Since conspiracy theories surrounding events such as 9/11 are popular, they are likely to appear high on such rankings, but this does not <u>mean</u> they are true.

(B) It was a <u>mean</u> trick to play on someone who trusted you completely.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 mean이 (A)와 (B)에서 각각 어떤 의미로 쓰였는지 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) mean=의미하다(동사), (B) mean=비열한(형용사)
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 의미하다 — (B) 평균의: (B) mean의 '평균의' 의미는 수치 맥락에만 씀. trick(속임수) 앞에서는 '비열한'
❌ ② (A) 의도하다 — (B) 비열한: (A) 'this does not mean they are true'에서 mean은 '의미하다'지 '의도하다'가 아님
✅ ③ (A) 의미하다 — (B) 비열한: 원문 (A)는 '그것이 사실임을 의미하지 않는다', (B)는 '비열한 속임수'
❌ ④ (A) 중요하다 — (B) 인색한: (A) mean은 '중요하다'(matter)가 아니라 '의미하다'(signify)
det.tip: mean 다의어: ① 의미하다(동사) ② 비열한(형용사) ③ 평균(명사/형용사) — 문맥으로 구분

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a person or thing regarded as an infallible authority or guide on something"

det.korean: infallible authority(절대적 권위자) or guide = oracle(신탁, 절대적 안내자)
det.analysis:
❌ ① expert: 전문가이나 'infallible'(절대 틀리지 않는) 권위자의 뉘앙스는 없음
✅ ② oracle: 고대 신탁에서 유래, 절대적이고 틀릴 수 없는 권위/안내자의 의미
❌ ③ database: 데이터베이스는 저장소이지 권위자/안내자가 아님
❌ ④ algorithm: 알고리즘은 절차/방법으로 권위자 개념과 다름
det.tip: electronic oracle(전자 신탁/오라클) — infallibly dispensing wisdom(절대 틀리지 않게 지혜를 전달하는)

questions.passage: Search engines like Google may help, but it is important to keep in mind that page rankings are __________ (determine) by popularity rather than truth.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: page rankings are _____(determine) by popularity — 수동태(be determined)
det.analysis: 수동태 구조: be동사(are) + 과거분사. determine → determined. 'rankings are determined by'에서 수동의 의미가 명확함
det.tip: be동사 + p.p. 수동태 구조. determine(결정하다) → determined(결정되는)

questions.passage: Since conspiracy theories surrounding events such as 9/11 are popular, they are likely to have __________ (appear) high on such rankings, but this does not mean they are true.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: be likely to have _____(appear) — 완료부정사(have appeared)
det.analysis: be likely to + have + p.p. 완료부정사 구조. appear → appeared(과거분사). 음모론이 이미 높은 순위에 올라와 있을 가능성을 나타냄
det.tip: be likely to have + p.p. 완료부정사 구조. appear(나타나다) → appeared(과거분사)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 검색 순위가 진실이 아닌 인기도로 결정된다는 예시 = 9/11 같은 사건을 둘러싼 음모론
det.analysis:
❌ ① views of credentialed experts: 자격 갖춘 전문가 견해는 신뢰도 높아 '허위지만 인기 있는' 예시로 부적절
✅ ② conspiracy theories surrounding events such as 9/11: 원문 일치. 인기 있지만 진실이 아닐 수 있는 대표적 예시
❌ ③ trustworthy information online: 신뢰할 수 있는 정보는 검색 순위의 문제점 예시로 부적절
❌ ④ critical thinking skills to evaluate it: 비판적 사고 기술은 능력이지 검색 순위에 오르는 콘텐츠가 아님
det.tip: Since _____ are popular, they are likely to appear high on such rankings — 인기 있지만 진실이 아닐 수 있는 것

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 잘못 인도되지 않으려면 정보를 찾는 능력뿐 아니라 = 비판적 사고 기술로 평가하는 능력
det.analysis:
❌ ① the ability to locate information: 정보를 찾는 능력은 이미 'not only' 부분에 언급됨. 'but also' 자리에 올 수 없음
❌ ② the wisdom to avoid popularity: 인기도를 피하는 지혜는 글의 결론이 아님. 인기도를 비판적으로 평가해야 하는 것
❌ ③ the knowledge to find truth online: 온라인에서 진실 찾는 지식은 '정보 위치 확인(locate)'과 유사하며, 'evaluate'의 의미가 없음
✅ ④ the critical thinking skills to evaluate it: 원문 일치. 정보를 찾는 능력(locate)만이 아니라 비판적으로 평가하는(evaluate) 능력 필요
det.tip: we need not only the ability to locate information, but also _____ — not only A but also B 구조의 B 자리

ch: the knowledge to find truth online
the critical thinking skills to evaluate it
